reason: The logic is right: sky_H only comes from sky_heights (23-28), so n = H - L - 1 is 15-27. Entry 1 is never the top, entry 4 always is, the carry chain holds, and A and X at .top are as before. The objection is room, not correctness. The candidate makes hazel_b 103 bytes bigger (hazel_b_end &DF65 -> &DFCC). It fits this branch's HAZEL (52 bytes left), but not the branches that main feeds. On gameplay-shield and hud-rupture, which contain main and must take its changes (flags-off byte-identical to main), the gameplay disc's HUD_RUPTURE puts level_movers_x_low, ground_columns and rup_k_lo/hi after sky_hazel in hazel_b. That fills HAZEL to &DFFF: build/strykers-gameplay.symbols.json shows hazel_b_end = &DFFF against the hazel_b_end <= &E000 ASSERT, so 0-1 bytes are free. Merged there, this change overruns HAZEL by about 103 bytes and the shipped gameplay disc no longer assembles. It also spends two thirds of this branch's last HAZEL room (the region where sky mode and the kind cache live) on about 40 cycles a pass in code that runs 0.65 times a pass. Candidate 2, the smaller alternative, is the one to take. Cycle recount (no page effects): the original's loop plus prelude is 119/183/247 cycles for 2/3/4 entries, the unrolled code 87/139/186, so it saves 32/44/61 cycles an execution.
